_note: Every value here is a documented assumption, not food data. Food data come from hemosense/data/foods_usda.csv (USDA FoodData Central).

iron_rda_mg._source: US NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Iron fact sheet (RDA). Verify against ICMR-NIN 2020 before clinical use in India.

absorption._source: Simplified model from the project design; ranges consistent with Hurrell & Egli 2010 (mixed diets 14-18 %, vegetarian 5-12 % bioavailability).

typical_bioavailability._source: Hurrell & Egli 2010 midpoints: mixed diet ~0.15, vegetarian ~0.10

exclude_in_pregnancy._source: Liver is very high in preformed vitamin A; pregnancy guidance (e.g. UK NHS) advises avoiding liver. Verify locally.
